name: Holvas
title: Warehouse Keeper

warehouse/30058.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: This warehouse is as safe as our long experience and unique technology can make it. Why, we've never lost so much as a single Adena!

warehouse/30058-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: Get a grip on yourself. I teach Dwarven Fighters, Scavengers and Bounty Hunters only. If you are an Artisan, go to a Blacksmith.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30058-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: Kamael... I am very curious about your race, but I'm afraid I'm absolutely swamped with work at the moment. Perhaps you could come back at another time...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30058-02.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: Kamael! What a surprise! I have so many questions for you. Oh, don't be offended -- we Dwarves are simply naturally curious, you know... How can I help you?

links.text: Tell me about the book written by the Giants concerning the Kamael.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30058-06.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: The manuscript pieces are 30 pages in total ... Go to the execution ground and eliminate the Amber Basilisk, Strain, Ghoul, Granite Golem, Corpse Pursuer and Hanged Man Ripper . Please gather the pieces of the manuscript and bring them to me as quickly as you can...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30058-07.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: You did it! Well done! Let me examine this. Hmmm... as I expected, I am already familiar with most of this content. It covers your race's physical appearance and combat prowess. Interesting, but not particularly unique... Wait a moment...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30058-09.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: When I hold these pages up to the light, I can see hidden words here Hmmm... These words are similar to the Kamael tongue, but they seem somehow older... Besides being written in a dead language, it also appears to be written in a code that I can't decipher... If you have s…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30058-10.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: I do not have any items that would interest you at the moment. Please come again later.

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30058-01.ht.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: What would Barbado like? Well, recently he was complaining about not having anything to wear to an event... Maybe he would like a new outfit!

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30058-02.ht.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: Hmmm, what would Barbado like to have? Well, he is a musician and has expressed an interest in learning to play a new instrument... Yes, I believe he mentioned that he wanted to learn to play the flute!

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30058-03.ht.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: I think Barbado would be happiest with a cold black beer after one of his musical performances!

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30058-04.ht.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: You know, come to think of it, a beer sounds pretty good to me, too! If you have the time, could you bring me one?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30058-03.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: How do you know about that?

links.text: I chanced to hear it from Poitan.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30058-04.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Holvas: Is that so? Well, if Poitan saw fit to tell you, then I guess I can tell you as well. There are many people who are curious about you, you know... That's why I think I can sell this manuscript for a handsome price! I was able to procure the manuscript secretly, and I intend…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30058-05.html.text: Warehouse keeper Holvas: Eliminate the Amber Basilisk, Strain, Ghoul, Granite Golem, Corpse Pursuer and Hanged Man Ripper . Then please gather the pieces of the manuscript -- it should be about 30 pages ... Please be careful...
